description: Agent Logistics: submit one shipment’s promised delivery window with its booking and arrival: the promise with the first and last days of the window promised to the buyer, when it was promised and the promise as the buyer was shown it; the booking with the service level, the transit days the booked service states as recorded, the day the shipment was handed to the carrier and the day it was booked; the arrival with the day it was delivered, or the carrier’s projected day with when that projection was recorded; each change to the window with its id, the new last day, when the buyer was told, the reason and whether the buyer accepted it; and optionally the day the window is read on. The signed report gives the promise with the window in force, the booked service’s earliest arrival from the handover against the window with the days available, the delivery or projected day against the window in force with the days late or early, and every change with the window it met and its status as moved, told after the window, declined or undated, and counts them, and names a missed window: a booked service whose transit time cannot meet the window, a delivery after the window in force, a projected delivery after it and a window passed with no delivery on the day read on; then a delivery inside a window moved by notice but after the promised one, a delivery before the window opened, a change told after the window in force had ended and a change the buyer declined, with the fix for each and what would change the verdict. No last day of the window, no delivery, projected or read-on day, no transit days or handover day for an undelivered shipment, or a change with no dates leaves the window unverified. This reads one shipment’s own window records: wever_shipping-check reads a shipping promise as quoted, computes its dispatch and delivery deadlines in calendar or business days and lists the dispatch, delivery and cost mismatches, while the window check reads whether the booked service could meet the window, the projected arrival before delivery and the window changes told to the buyer; a vendor’s delivery promise before the spend is wever_vendor-delivery-check and an agent’s commitments projected against their due dates are wever_commitment-slippage-check. Verdict logistics_window_missed, logistics_window_partial, logistics_window_unverified or logistics_window_met. POST /api/logistics-window-check. Reads the logistics records supplied in the call and returns a signed report with the verdict, the evidence read, the findings with their fixes, and what would change the verdict; the records stay in the report, with no network request, fetch, message, payment, shipment booking, label purchase or external write. Agent Logistics reads a shipment’s logistics records after the fact, from the shipment’s own records: the shipment record against the order it serves, the promised delivery window against the booking and the arrival, the carrier’s terms against what was agreed, the tracking events for one shipment, the address across the order, the label and the carrier record, the customs material for a cross-border shipment, proof of delivery against the delivery terms and exception handling when something went wrong. Beside it, wever_shipping-check reads a shipping promise against its delivery evidence and reports the dispatch, delivery and cost mismatches with the days late and the amount over, while a logistics check reads one shipment’s booking, carrier, tracking, address, customs, delivery and exception records against the order, the promise made to the buyer and the terms agreed; wever_vendor-delivery-check reads a vendor’s whole delivery promise before the spend, while a logistics check reads one shipment’s own records after it shipped; and wever_boutique-record-shipment and wever_boutique-confirm-delivery record and confirm a boutique order’s shipment and delivery, while a logistics check reads the records and changes none. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-logistics-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-logistics/.

delivered_on.description: The day the shipment was delivered, if it was, such as 2026-12-02.

projected_on.description: The carrier’s projected delivery day, for a shipment not yet delivered, such as 2026-12-02.

projected_recorded_on.description: When the projection was recorded, such as 2026-12-02.

as_of.description: The day the window is read on, for a shipment not yet delivered, such as 2026-12-02.

booked_on.description: When the shipment was booked, such as 2026-12-02.

service_level.description: The service level booked, as recorded.

shipped_on.description: The day the shipment was handed to the carrier, such as 2026-12-02.

transit_days.description: The transit days the booked service states, as recorded.

changes.description: Each change to the window, as recorded.

accepted.description: Whether the buyer accepted the change, as recorded.

communicated_on.description: When the buyer was told of the change, such as 2026-12-02.

new_window_end.description: The new last day of the window, such as 2026-12-02.

label.description: Optional name recorded in the report.

promised_on.description: When the window was promised, such as 2026-12-02.

text.description: The promise as the buyer was shown it.

window_end.description: The last day of the window promised to the buyer, such as 2026-12-02.

window_start.description: The first day of the window promised to the buyer, such as 2026-12-02.

title: Logistics window check
